Visual direction: Calm vibe, salvia green primary (#4a7c59), Inter body, Cormorant Garamond headings.
Source prompt:

You are designing a Calm-style yoga studio web application.

Functional context:
- Platform for managing a yoga studio: students book classes, teachers run sessions, admins manage memberships and the catalogue.
- Roles: admin, teacher, student.
- Primary entities: User, Class, Booking, Membership.

Visual hints (tentative — feel free to adapt):
- primarySeed: #4a7c59 (salvia green; calm, natural)
- vibeMood: calm
- sansSuggestion: Inter (or DM Sans)
- displaySuggestion: Cormorant Garamond (for hero headings)
- voice: calm / tone: intimate (microcopy will be injected later by the Visual Adapter)

Space, Rhythm, and Flow

Our practice is rooted in community, mindful movement, and the quiet power of a single, intentional breath.

Frequently Asked Questions

help_outline How do credits work?

Credits are added to your account on the first of every month. Each credit is valid for one 60 or 90-minute studio class. Credits do not roll over to the next month.

pause_circle Can I pause my membership?

Yes, you can pause your membership for up to 3 months per calendar year. Please notify us at least 7 days before your next billing cycle to initiate a pause.

cancel What is the cancellation policy?

We require a 30-day notice for all membership cancellations. You can manage your subscription directly through your profile settings.
